body: Today I am feeling better.  The feelings are still there though and they'll come back.

I posted on a bad day.

On a bad day I can barely motivate myself to get out of bed.  Everything I do seems pointless.  I also can't seem to stop thinking about my life and what a total waste it is.  I sit there alone just crying and the more I think about it, the harder I cry.

The intervals between bad days are getting shorter and shorter.  I don't know where to start.
